items.summary: Formula 1 reports that Haas will run Rafael Camara alongside Ollie Bearman in Sao Paulo and that Esteban Ocon will not return this season. Camara was already signed for 2027.

analysis.text: Haas brings its 2027 driver into a race seat early. That creates an earlier evaluation opportunity alongside Bearman, but this announcement establishes no result or improvement in race pace.
analysis.basis: Full Formula1.com article; publication timestamp and team statements read. Team reasoning beyond its public statement and Camara’s race performance are unknown.

items.summary: The NBA announced a one-game suspension for Kingston Flemings following an October 31 incident, scheduled to be served against Indiana on November 2.

analysis.text: The sanction meant a short rotation adjustment rather than an indefinite absence. This is a dated November 1 disciplinary announcement, not a fresh November 4 injury or suspension update.
